verifications.claim: Artemis II uses NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Artemis II mission blasted off... atop the... Space Launch System (SLS) rocket'; R2: 'NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket will launch the second Orion spacecraft'; R5: 'Orion will launch on NASA’s... SLS (Space Launch System)'; R6: 'The Artemis II mission will launch using the SLS (Space Launch System) rocket'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state that Artemis II launches on the SLS rocket.

verifications.claim: NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is the most powerful rocket NASA has ever built.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'the most powerful rocket NASA has ever built'; R4: 'SLS is one of the most powerful rockets to ever launch... 15% more thrust than the Saturn V'; R6: 'SLS is one of the most powerful rockets to ever launch'
verifications.reasoning: R1 directly states it is the most powerful NASA has built; others support with thrust comparisons.

verifications.claim: NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is a heavy-lift vehicle.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'NASA’s new heavy-lift rocket, the SLS (Space Launch System)'; R6: 'This heavy-lift launch vehicle'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe SLS as a heavy-lift rocket/vehicle.

verifications.claim: NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket is specifically designed for deep space missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'testing new technologies designed for deep space exploration—namely the SLS'; R4: 'extend human existence to deep space... NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket will propel... to travel around the Moon and back'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly link SLS design to deep space exploration and missions.

verifications.claim: NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket launches the Orion spacecraft.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'SLS rocket will launch the second Orion spacecraft'; R4: 'SLS rocket will propel the crewed Orion spacecraft'; R5: 'SLS... can send Orion... directly to the Moon'
verifications.reasoning: All sources confirm SLS launches Orion for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: The Orion spacecraft carries four astronauts.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'a team of four astronauts'; R2: 'carrying four astronauts'; R6: 'a crew of four astronauts'
verifications.reasoning: Every source specifies four astronauts aboard Orion for Artemis II.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is a lunar flyby mission
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R5: 'Crewed Lunar Flyby'; R1: 'slingshot around the moon'; R6: 'fly around the Moon'; R7: 'around the Moon and back'
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently describe Artemis II as a flyby or fly-around of the Moon, not orbit or landing.
